notes: A window is the run of days with no school (elementary), with a Saturday that touches the break included: start = the first free day a family can fly out, end = the last free day they can fly back.
Holiday dates (holiday_start/holiday_end) follow the Israel schedule from hebcal [H]. Hanukkah is its 8 daytime days (the first candle is lit the evening before).
2026-27 (תשפ"ז): the Ministry of Education vacation calendar, copied word for word in [R] and matched by [M] and [K]. All three agree on every break.

2027-28 (תשפ"ח): the Ministry calendar was not yet published when checked on 2026-10-14. These breaks are PREDICTED by applying the 2026-27 pattern to the hebcal holiday dates, and they are marked confirmed=false. The least certain are the start of the Passover break and the summer dates. Check them again once the Ministry publishes, usually in the winter or spring before.
Summer: elementary schools and kindergartens are off from 1 July. Middle and high schools are off from about 20/21 June.

sources.R: https://rng.org.il/uploads/n/1785678884.5499.pdf (לוח חופשות תשפ"ז, a copy of the Ministry calendar, 2026-08-02)

windows.name: Yom Kippur 2026
windows.note: Bridge days 22–24 Sep lead straight into the Sukkot break.

windows.name: Sukkot 2026
windows.note: A single break from the eve of Yom Kippur to Simchat Torah. Back to school Sun 4 Oct.

windows.name: Hanukkah 2026
windows.note: No school Sun 6 – Sat 12 Dec. Back Sun 13 Dec.

windows.name: Passover 2027
windows.note: Seder night is Wed 21 Apr. Back to school Thu 29 Apr (Isru Chag is a school day).

windows.name: Independence Day 2027
windows.note: Only Wed 12 May is a day off school; on Yom HaZikaron the day before, school ends at 12:00. A long weekend means missing Thursday and Friday.

windows.name: Summer vacation 2027
windows.note: Elementary schools are off from 1 Jul, middle and high schools from 21 Jun. School starts Wed 1 Sep 2027.

windows.name: Passover 2028
windows.note: Seder night is Mon 10 Apr 2028. The first day of the break is a guess (around 2–4 Apr).

windows.name: Independence Day 2028
windows.note: Observed Tue 2 May: 5 Iyar falls on a Monday and is postponed by a day.
